scope: Dashboard-only descriptive EDA and compact references; no training, model selection, notebook/report/slide changes or extract regeneration.

local_checks.guide_smoke_check: Collapsed references render, internal-work link buttons and raw manifest JSON absent.
numerical_fixture_coverage: Exact fractional-day and right-closed boundary bins including zero and full >60-day tail.
Negative/invalid timings and absent outcomes kept distinct.
Observed integer 1–5 reviews only, low reviews 1–2, no missing review as a label.
Fixed feature groups preserve all selected and eligible counts.
min_n=30 uses eligible outcomes; small groups retain counts and blank estimates.
Pointwise 95% Wilson bounds, including all-zero/all-one groups.

interpretation_limits: Descriptive cohort includes valid recorded deliveries regardless of final order status; it differs from regression evaluation.
Review extract lacks answer timestamps and cannot recreate the classifier T-eligible cohort.
Payment method may finalize shortly after purchase.
Groups are descriptive associations, not causal effects, model importance or a new feature-selection result.
New charts use fractional elapsed days; older explorer summaries retain floored day fields.
